title: Declared backup coverage generated from configuration
objective: Ensure every authoritative store is backed up at a frequency that meets its data-class RPO and that exclusions are explicit and justified by a tested rebuild path.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Immutable backups in a separate security domain
objective: Prevent deletion or alteration of backups by any production, administrator or agent identity during the retention period, by storing them in a separate account with retention lock.
implementing_systems: Cloud backup vault with retention lock (provider not selected)
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)
residual_risks: Compliance-mode retention locks cannot be shortened, which conflicts with deletion requests until expiry.

title: Backup encryption with independently recoverable keys
objective: Encrypt backups with keys held outside production key scope and keep an escrowed recovery path tested annually.
owner: Proposed: Security Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Dual-controlled restore operations
objective: Require two authorized people for any restore into production, log the action as tamper-evident evidence, and deny agents the ability to initiate production restores.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Scheduled restore with financial integrity verification
objective: Restore a sample of each data class on a schedule and verify integrity cryptographically and by trial balance, not only by successful job completion.
owner: Proposed: SRE Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Append-only journal with side-effect-free replay
objective: Make the authoritative ledger strictly append-only and make replay deterministic and incapable of emitting external effects, so state can be reconstructed to any point.

title: Backup-aware retention and destruction
objective: Track personal and tenant data in backups through expiry, honor legal holds, and state residual backup copies in destruction certificates rather than claiming immediate deletion.
owner: Proposed: Privacy Lead (role not yet staffed)
